about_the_game:
A collection of Mind Limiter items including:

“Mind Limiter” - Suppresses SAN from rising in the next battle.
“Mind Limiter x3” - Suppresses SAN from rising in the next battle (3 time use.)
“Mind Limiter x5” - Suppresses SAN from rising in the next battle (5 time use.)

Use these items via the Setup\Items\DLC sub-menu from the Lobby.
